findings.explanation: Shirou’s angry, directly addressed rebuke becomes a generic refusal.

findings.governingReading: the reverse of what he had been doing until now
findings.explanation: The explicit reversal from trying to free himself to fastening the chain disappears, weakening the deliberateness of Shirou’s choice.

findings.highlight: I grab onto the chain so that it won’t let me go.
findings.evidenceJa: 決して離れないよう鎖を掴み
findings.governingReading: He grips the chain so that he himself will never come loose.
findings.explanation: The purpose of Shirou’s grip is reassigned to the chain’s agency, blurring his active decision to bind Gilgamesh’s fate to his own.

findings.highlight: I fall into the eternal darkness
findings.evidenceJa: 際限なく闇に落ちていく。
findings.governingReading: He keeps falling into the darkness without end.
findings.explanation: Endlessness modifies Shirou’s ongoing fall; mirror moon instead makes the darkness itself eternal.

findings.highlight: melts my skin, shaves off my flesh, and removes my bones.
findings.evidenceJa: 容赦なくこの身を蝕む黒い泥。
findings.governingReading: Black mud mercilessly eats away at this body.
findings.explanation: The mature branch invents an ordered skin-flesh-bone disassembly absent from the active Japanese sentence.
The image of Shirou’s body as a removable shell around the soul becomes generic bodily loss.
The destination at a profound bottom is replaced by generic darkness already supplied on the prior page.

findings.highlight: I feel like I’m going up after a while
findings.evidenceJa: 昇っているような錯覚の後
findings.governingReading: after the illusion that he is rising rather than falling
findings.explanation: The explicit reversal illusion caused by the overlong fall becomes a looser feeling of upward movement.

findings.governingReading: a black sun shaped like a cup
findings.explanation: The defining black color is omitted, while unsupported size is added and the ordinary cup image is prematurely fixed as the Grail.
